'''Kiros birds''' were a species of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]]. [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] kept some Kiros birds as pets during the [[Battle of Kiros]] and planned to sell them had the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] not captured him. They were gentle animals, and were very tame. They also appeared to be quite intelligent little creatures, as one laughed when it saw [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flirting with [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]].

They were remarkably similar in appearance to the [[Convor/Legends|convorees]], but with different-colored plumage.<ref name="Kidnapped Episode Guide" />
